item.description:
Release v5.24.0

Changes since v5.23.2

  • feat: add cloud provider selector to onboarding
  • feat: Deselect conversation when current project changes
  • feat: support replaying onboarding
  • feat(ask-user): show pending question in V1 chat area
  • feat(KernelCore): add SuperLog support and verbose logging control
  • feat(message-list-brief): add post-send positioning
  • feat(message-list): distinguish verbosity mode icons
  • feat(message-rendering): color debug renderers and inline single tool calls
  • feat(onboarding): support adding custom LLM providers in onboarding
  • feat(PluginDeveloperMode): add developer mode toolbar toggle
  • feat(PluginDeveloperMode): show debug build badge
  • feat(PluginGit): skip GitLogRowRenderer custom rendering in V1 brief mode
  • feat(PluginMessageRenderer): show tool call renderer ID badge in debug mode
  • feat(PluginModelSelector): sort model list by id alphabetically
  • feat(PluginPerformanceMetrics): add localization support
  • feat(PluginProjects): add "Add Project" button to settings header
  • feat(PluginProjects): add "Open in Finder" button to project overview section
  • feat(PluginWelcome): pass title when registering onboarding page
  • feat(ProviderDeveloperMode): add runtime developer mode provider
  • feat(ProviderOnboarding): add title property to OnboardingPageItem
